summary: Frontend test of Óptica Dashboard (Rentabilidad + Informes) for accessories inclusion. Accessories feature WORKS: 'Accesorios' row renders (4 / Q150 / Q50 / Q100 / 66.7%) for Hoy/Mes; Semana shows Aros+Accesorios; Año shows Aros/Monturas, Lentes de Contacto, Tipos de Lente, Accesorios. Period switching refreshes cards and table with no JS errors. Informes Nov 2026 Top 10 lists 'ACC: NovaVision Estuche rigido' (2, Q90) and 'ACC: TESTBrand TEST_Estuche_...' (2, Q60). BLOCKERS: (1) the optica role CANNOT open /optica/dashboard because the frontend route and sidebar item are superadmin-only, so I ran the test as superadmin. (2) A long-standing field mismatch: dashboard code reads 'paid_amount' but sales are saved with 'total_paid'. Because of this, Cobrado shows Q0, the Pagado column shows 'Q NaN', and Balance Ingresos is Q0 even though orders are marked 'pagado'.

critical.issue: Uses field 'paid_amount' but optica_sales documents store 'total_paid' (see create sale lines 1230/1431/1474 and payments line 1516). Result: total_cobrado=0, saldo_pendiente=total, informe balance.ingresos=0, ventas-dia rows lack paid_amount -> UI 'Q NaN'. Verified in DB: ORD-202611-0001 has total_paid, status 'pagado', no paid_amount.

minor.issue: Lentes de Contacto costos Q0.00 -> margen 100%; cost is probably missing for contact lens items (check cost lookup for contact lens in items_v2/legacy).

ui_bugs.issue: Route uses requiredRole='superadmin' and sidebar item needs isSuperAdmin, so the optica user (optica/Optica2024$) is sent to /pacientes. The user asked for everything to appear on the óptica dashboard, but óptica users cannot reach it. The backend already allows view_optica.
Pagado column shows 'Q NaN' (venta.paid_amount undefined; field is total_paid)

integration_issues.issue: Cobrado Hoy Q0.00 / Pendiente Q150 and Informe 'Cobrado Q0.00', 'Balance Ingresos Q0.00' even though both orders are 'pagado'. Same root cause as the paid_amount/total_paid mismatch.

issues: The td has the CSS class 'capitalize', so labels render as 'Lentes De Contacto' and 'Tipos De Lente'. Remove 'capitalize' because the labels are already mapped.

action_items: Replace 'paid_amount' with 'total_paid' (or use a $ifNull fallback) across the optica dashboard endpoints in routes/optica.py, and use venta.total_paid in the OpticaDashboard Ventas del Día table
Allow the optica role to open /optica/dashboard: change the App.js route to requiredPermission='view_optica' and update the Layout.js sidebar condition (if the user wants óptica staff to see it)
Remove 'capitalize' from the category label td in OpticaDashboard.js
Check the contact lens cost calculation in rentabilidad (costos Q0 -> 100% margin)
critical_code_review_comments: paid_amount vs total_paid schema drift breaks every 'cobrado' metric on the dashboard
Dashboard is superadmin-gated on the frontend while the backend permits view_optica, which is inconsistent

success_rate.frontend: 80% - accessories/category/top-products features pass; cobrado/pagado figures wrong; optica role blocked

test_credentials: optica/Optica2024$ (blocked from dashboard), superadmin/nova2024 (used for UI test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nov 2026 has 2 accessory sales (ORD-202611-0001 Q90, -0002 Q60, both status pagado, total_paid field). After the fix, Cobrado Hoy should be Q150, the Pagado column should show numbers, Informe balance ingresos should be Q150, and the optica user should reach /optica/dashboard.
rca of the issue: Sale creation (routes/optica.py ~1230/1431) writes 'total_paid'/'balance_due'. Dashboard aggregations sum '$paid_amount', which doesn't exist, so they get 0 and the frontend gets undefined (formatCurrency gives NaN).
